description: Source-bound correspondence inventory; hashing does not itself establish manuscript correctness.

current_arxiv.mapping_policy: Independent labels, not original counters; re-evaluate after manuscript changes.

scope_policy.complete: Named conclusion under literal modeled hypotheses and described scope; separately inventoried surrounding claims excluded.
scope_policy.restricted: Substantial proof exists; stated explicit bridge/endpoint/classification/export remains.
scope_policy.open: No complete checked proof in checkpoint.
scope_policy.not_claimed: Open problem or expressly disclaimed claim.

claims.title: Closed scalar feasibility iff
claims.verified_scope: Actual complex symmetric two-port contractions; all closed T,a,delta endpoints. Specified-matrix phase classification is separately inventoried.

claims.title: Two-branch scalar absorption ceiling
claims.verified_scope: Universal sharp ceiling and actual literal real-root S* optimizer, including active branch, plateau and closed endpoints.

claims.title: Complex modulus comparison
claims.verified_scope: Actual continuous piecewise Helmholtz fields; p bounded above only on selected interval, q nonnegative. No lower bound on real p or exterior cap.

claims.title: One-period capped Fourier moment
claims.verified_scope: Interval-integrable real q, caps on open interval, exact zero/full endpoints.

claims.title: Cell determinant and combining cells
claims.verified_scope: Actual-field cell estimate in canonical fundamental-state deposited Gram basis and genuine PSD aggregation; total normalized invariant linked to scattering determinant.
claims.remaining_obligations: Explicit exported congruence/determinant identity converting each selected-cell deposited Gram to original unit-incidence A_J is not yet in checkpoint.

claims.title: Convexity and global supporting tangent
claims.verified_scope: Exact half-period convexity, small-mean tangent over full period, explicit polynomial lower bound.

claims.title: Broad selected-interval resource floor
claims.verified_scope: Literal piecewise Helmholtz profile PDE model allows p=0 and p<0 and arbitrary passive exterior. Caps only on selected interval; exact normalized actual scattering determinant finite floor and uniform large-L lower limit. Hypotheses specify actual PDE/continuity/integrability, not desired Gram bounds.

claims.title: Strict nonattainment of finite resource floors
claims.verified_scope: Nonnegative finite floors and positive invariant proved; strict inequality above finite beta floor is not asserted.
claims.remaining_obligations: Strict modulus comparison on positive-measure lossy field pairs and resulting strict beta resource bound not formalized.

claims.title: Sharp exact-target finite-layer thickness asymptotic
claims.verified_scope: Unchanged OQ7 PhysicalParameters actual finite layers, exact active target, all-budget optimum, eventual exact feasibility, finite strict gap and sharp asymptotic coefficient. Global 1<=p<=P as original Section5.

claims.title: Minimum-thickness inverse asymptotic
claims.verified_scope: Actual sInf of thicknesses of exact-target stacks within eta of ceiling; literal equation43 ratio tends to1 as eta decreases to0.

claims.title: Reciprocity and signed channel power difference
claims.verified_scope: Arbitrary complex Hilbert space, genuine conjugation, actual transpose reciprocity/lossless reference. Extinction equality derived.

claims.title: Sharp channel extinction parabola
claims.verified_scope: Arbitrary Hilbert upper, exact equality iff/endpoints, and same-Hilbert actual finite orthogonal reversed-input sharp witnesses for all X in[0,4].

claims.title: Scalar golden contrast and fixed-X curve
claims.verified_scope: Actual complex two-port universal/attained gamma=sqrt(10sqrt5-22); full equation50 curve. Actual capped finite dielectric sequence approaches gamma with exact target/loss budget and bounded counted phase correction.

claims.title: Finite-coefficient normal-incidence planar realization
claims.verified_scope: Actual two-layer E/H fields, constitutive law, interface/exterior matching for every four-port amplitude; full 3D tensor with zz=1, caps and passivity. Exact reference/extinction/asymmetry, fixed-X parabola/relative-one supremum, positive loss budget with one zero absorptance. Frequency-domain theorem only.

claims.title: Finite-power angular-spectrum planar beams
claims.verified_scope: Normal-incidence physical fields and limiting sharpness verified. C-only oblique transfer and vacuum basis are outside checkpoint.
claims.remaining_obligations: Complete oblique scattering/continuity, power-flux and Parseval L2 identification, finite-power reversed beam, exact-extinction tuning still required. Generic averaging alone is insufficient.

claims.title: Full prescribed-overlap envelope for 0<rho<1
claims.verified_scope: Arbitrary Hilbert reciprocal contraction and reciprocal bounded reference S0 with S0.adjoint.comp S0=id; actual u/reversed-u overlap, all X in[0,4], three branches and exact finite-dimensional same-observable attainability.
claims.remaining_obligations: Original statement also asserts explicit 2/3 channel dimension bounds and continuous branch gluing: proof witnesses and continuous parameterized graph are checked, but explicit public dimension-bound and ContinuousOn envelope wrappers remain.

claims.title: Specified complex-matrix phase criterion after equation4
claims.verified_scope: Existence iff of Prop2.1 is formalized.
claims.remaining_obligations: Specified triple iff in terms of arg(rL)+arg(rR)-2arg(t), including zero-entry degeneracies, is not exported.

claims.verified_scope: Sharp values and one actual optimizer across all closed branches are formalized.
claims.remaining_obligations: Complete classification of every maximizing complex matrix and all degenerate phase/singular-spectrum families remains.
